_comment: Schema + example for briefs/latest.json. The agent writes this file; the voice room reads `script` (falls back to `text`) — the only required field. `items[].sources` should be structured objects ({author,id,url}), not bare handles: the live voice room passes this as GROUNDING to the model so follow-up questions get answered from the exact source post instead of a broad re-search. Legacy bare-string sources still work but lose that grounding benefit.
title: Your X brief — Wed Jul 8
script: Good morning! Three things are moving in your feed.
